newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends steady after brief session.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends steady after brief session.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed unchanged at 14.27 ringgit ($5.76) a kg, after a brief trading session as bids and offers were matched at the opening price, traders said.
They said a steady London Metal Exchange (LME) on Friday supported the price.
Turnover was 105 tonnes, down from 123 on Friday, and buyers were from Europe and Malaysia.
The local price premium over LME narrowed further to $5 a tonne from $15 previously.
